facts.text: Maria shared a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard, emphasizing the importance of taking time for oneself and loved ones.

evidence.quote: Finding balance is crucial. Taking time for ourselves and the important people in our lives is vital.
That beach pic you shared reminded me of a special vacation we had to California- a gorgeous sunset and an awesome night strolling the shore, creating memories together.

facts.text: Maria mentioned a vacation in Florida where she felt a sense of gratitude while sitting with her family, and shared a photo of a sunset over a body of water with a bird flying in the distance.

evidence.quote: I have a picture from a vacation in Florida. The colors were amazing, and I had a feeling of gratitude just sitting there with my family.
That photo is so stunning. The colors there are so vivid - it must have been amazing!

facts.text: John shared a photo of two children playing in the ocean waves, describing it as a joyful and carefree time during a family vacation.

evidence.quote: Here's one from our vacation! [image: a photo of two children playing in the ocean waves]
The kids look so happy splashing in the waves. It must have been such a joyful and carefree time!
